cs.t: That Model M SSK looks real nice. I have not one but two Filco Majestouch 2 TKL with brown MX keys, one for 12 years and counting. They are so much heavier, nicer compared to what I got recently second hand: a WASD with a very wobbly case.
While we're on the topic, I've got an aging WASD that I created the keycaps for, made them fully Mac but an ISO layout. Why are en_US ISO 105-key layout keyboards so hard to find?

I love the Kinesis ergo keyboards, but also the ThinkPad bluetooth keyboard (no reaching for the mouse = less wrist pain). Also a fan of WASD's keyboards, but keep in mind that their custom keycaps seem to wear down pretty fast. Check  https://www.reddit.com/r/MechanicalKeyboards/  for pretty much any/all options on the keyboard front.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's the best desktop keyboard for Mac users?

cs.t: I have a WASD mechanical, but lately I have just been using my Apple Magic Keyboard. For awhile I hated it because it's so small and compact, but have really fallen in love with it recently.
cs.th: Ask HN: What Keyboard do you use?
